## Information
Bring festive cheer to your home and garden with this charming Outdoor LED Candy Cane Decoration, designed to create a warm and welcoming Christmas atmosphere. Available in two impressive sizes, 120cm and 150cm, this eye-catching decoration makes a stunning addition to driveways, gardens, pathways, and festive displays. Designed for outdoor use, the candy cane comes with a 5m transparent cable and a BS IP20 transformer, allowing safe and flexible placement around your home. Perfect for adding a touch of Christmas magic to parties, festive entrances, and winter pathways, this LED Candy Cane brings a classic holiday look with a bright, modern glow. Whether displayed alone or paired with other festive lights, it’s sure to become a highlight of your seasonal décor year after year.

Give guests a bright festive welcome with the Christow Merry Christmas Rope Light Sign. Available in 100cm and 185cm sizes, it features clear white lettering with a sweeping red flourish and flashing green holly leaves for a vibrant light display. ## Information
CHRISTMAS LIGHTS: Let your home shine brighter with this set of NETTA LED Cool White Christmas Icicle Lights that feature 480 beaming bulbs. These lustrous lights are sure to add a sparkle to your home or a glimmer to your garden over the festive season by enhancing the traditional Christmas theme. Not only are they perfect for Christmas, but they are ideal for any outdoor gathering or for serving a desirable decoration for parties and events. 8 HOURS ON TIMER SETTING: The timer function allows your lights to turn automatically when it gets dark. To activate the timer, please hold the power button for 3 seconds until it turns green. You will then be able to select your preferred lighting mode and the lights will remain on for 8 hours and turn off for 16 automatically. To turn off the timer, please hold the power button for 3 seconds until it turns white. 8 FUNCTIONS WITH MEMORY: This set of multifunctional string lights features 8 lighting modes to choose from, including Combination, Steady On, Slow Fade, In Waves, Slow Glow, Chasing/Flash, Sequential and Twinkle/Flash. The different lighting effects are controlled by a button on the plug adapter which make it easier than ever to achieve your desired lighting effects. SAFE FOR INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE: These lights are extra safe due to the low-voltage, mains-powered UK plug with a 31V low voltage adapter, which is IP44 rated, meaning that you can use this product both indoors and outdoors. A 5M lead wire ensures easy installation of these lights.
